kind: Fixed-bin development diagnostics; not a validation protocol
reference_measure: logarithmic host mass; log-orthopolic collisionless total-matter candidate
mass_coordinate: x=ln(M/m_p)=log2(N)*ln(2); N is the exact integer host particle count
bin_rule: [lower, upper); an exact upper-edge value belongs to the next bin; diffuse is state 0 with no logarithmic mass
domain_rule: N from 1 through 2^E exclusive; E is the smallest positive even integer with 2^E > N_total; fail if any positive host lies outside
drift_reading: HH endpoint-conditioned departure-bin mean displacement/dt times its matched HH starting stock per logarithmic width; all-host stock and retained HH fraction reported separately
current_reading: Signed HH endpoint boundary crossings; cell averages use exact clipped endpoint integrals, not edge interpolation
residual_reading: Finite-time spatial localization residual; not a bound on physical continuum closure
skip_bin_definition: Absolute departure/arrival bin-index difference at least 2, evaluated separately for each grid
stationarity_reading: Descriptive endpoint stock-rate changes and change divided by mean endpoint stock; no acceptance threshold
cadence_reading: Duration-integrated adjacent-minus-coarse currents and sources; gross HH differences on the full population can be signed. The subset hosted at all three outputs separately tests telescoping net currents and nonnegative gross crossing loss.
exposure_note: Global inventory, jump and cadence diagnostics were already exposed on 21 November; grids and estimands are fixed now before new mass-bin summaries. The entire run remains development-only.
